sources.title: Government of the Republic of Kosovo: Decision No. 14/280 of 19 December 2025
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The actual signed government PDF opened. PDF page 29, Decision 14/280, specifically introduces a visa regime for Fiji citizens and directs MFA, Interior and Police implementation. Paragraph 4 makes entry into force conditional on publication in the Official Gazette. The government-hosted decision is not itself treated as proof of that publication.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vendimi hyn në fuqi ditën e publikimit në Gazetën Zyrtare të Republikës së Kosovës.

sources.title: Kosovo Visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Diaspora of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The actual Kosovo embassy-network visa page opened and identifies the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Diaspora. It describes foreign visit visas and short-stay visa exemptions, directly naming Fixhi in the exempt-country list. No editorial date resolving its relationship to Decision 14/280 is supplied.

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: Fiji visa-regime amendment has an unverified Official Gazette effective trigger
conflicts.explanation: The signed decision directly contradicts the live MFA short-stay list if its Gazette-publication trigger has occurred. Fresh actual Gazette searches, including decision-number and Fiji-content queries with an independently working visa-title search, did not retrieve that publication. Search absence is not proof of nonpublication, so neither the signature date nor the still-live exemption list safely decides current force.

unresolved.reason: Current ordinary-passport visitor treatment is not established. The signed 19 December 2025 Fiji amendment makes legal effect depend on Official Gazette publication, while the actual MFA visitor page continues to name Fiji as exempt. Current Gazette searches retrieved no publication of Decision 14/280 and no later controlling Fiji act; this is a retrieval gap, not proof the decision remains ineffective. A publication record or an operative consolidated rule is required before selecting visa-free or a prior-visa route, and issuance timing would also need confirmation for any replacement visa category.
